metadata.name: Wilson-HR
metadata.author: Wilson, H. R.
metadata.description: Wilson 1999 continuous two-state polynomial cortical-neuron model

extensions.silicon_cosim_note: The hand model, paired schemas, and Q16.16 RTL preserve the source capacitance and continuous no-reset flow; events are observational sampled upward crossings of v=0.
extensions.source_equation_note: Wilson 1999 Eq. 9.7: C*dV/dt with C=0.8, tau_R=1.9 ms, continuous limit-cycle spikes, and no threshold reset.
extensions.identity_note: The historical unit-capacitance hard-reset recurrence is separately named SCResettingWilsonHRNeuron.
